_comment: Wording lab, round 2 of the selfie mode (docs/ROADMAP.md, F4). Round 1
(selfie.json, rendered 2026-09-30) adopted Selfie von oben, auf Augenhöhe,
im Liegen, Spiegel-Selfie, Kusshand, Peace-Zeichen and the smartphone
genre; these five did not come out and get new wordings here, each against
its bare word. Same person, seeds and 9:16 format as round 1.
Group A: the camera slot, the framing's wording first (kamera_mit_ausschnitt).
A low angle has to be forced by what only a low angle shows - the underside
of the chin and jaw, the nostrils, the ceiling behind the head, the phone
held below the face - rather than by naming the angle, which round 1 did.
Over the shoulder needs the back to the lens: round 1 turned the body only
slightly, so these candidates are rendered as a medium shot, where the back
and shoulder fit into the frame. The adopted 'Selfie von oben' (it came out
only slightly above eye level) is the reference row of a steeper
alternative.
Group B: the expression slot with the camera gaze, next to the adopted
eye-level selfie (the built-in perspective, as a series sends it). The eye
roll runs without the camera gaze, as in round 1: it looks away.
The format is tools/wortlabor.py's (photoshoot-wortlabor/1); a
{"preset": "perspektive/<label>"} in the camera slot is an adopted
perspective of nodes/shooting.py.
